ai_summary: Aster DM Quality Care Limited announced a planned refresh of its Board, with Independent Director Ms. Purana Housdurgam Vijayadeepti retiring upon term completion and Ms. Neela Bhattacherjee appointed as a new Independent Director, bringing extensive experience in IT and business strategy. This transition ensures continuity of independent oversight and reconstitutes several key committees, subject to shareholder approval for Ms. Bhattacherjee's term. The changes reflect routine board governance procedures and present no immediate red flags.
